draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.20, the 91st-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 14th of 39 at LB. He went 87th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Kyle Van Noy. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 83 tackles in 2019, 15th of 39 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the New Orleans Saints. 75 career games and 40 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2023. Versus the typical Year-6 edge rusher who played: 2.0 sacks against a median of 3.5, below the norm.
